facts.text: I am interested in whether digital check-ins have reduced the number of lost luggage incidents at airports.
I am interested in examples of innovative baggage tracking devices and platforms implemented by airlines in recent years.
I find retrieving luggage from the baggage carousel frustrating during travel.
